answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 251 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the terrace challenge, the glacier audit can replay the wander history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 839 identities would post 2273 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
